sn13.11:1.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso Sinerussa pabbatarājassa satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhipeyya || ||
sn13.11:1.4: Katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ || yā vā satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā yo vā Sineru pabbatarājāti || || 3
sn13.11:2.1: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idaṃ Sineru pabbatarājā ||
sn13.11:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalam upenti na sahassimam kalam upenti na satasahassimaṃ kalam upenti Sinerupabattarājānam upanidhāya satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā ti || || 4
sn13.11:3.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa adhigamam upanidhāya aññatitthiya-samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakānaṃ adhigamo neva satimaṃ kalam upeti na sahassimaṃ kalam upeti na satasahassimam kalam upeti || || 5
sn13.11:3.2: Evam mahādhigamo bhikkhave diṭṭhisampanno puggalo evam mahābhiññoti || ||
sn13.11:4.4: Tayo ca Pabbatūpamā ti || || (Section I Ajjhatta-pañcakaṃ) 1
